en.headline: 405 own commits and 715 automated ones across 11 repos, plus 34 issue actions
en.teaser: Most of the window went into the daily-report pipeline, an OpenCode agent sandbox, skill management and a translation extension, with four releases of the Go model picker.
en.overview:
### Own projects

Work centred on the daily-report repository `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, where the AI summary layer was reworked: the duplicate empty gate was removed, blank days no longer swallow discussion sections, and commits from non-GitHub email aliases are now attributed correctly. A new 30-day GitHub activity AI summary was added as both a home-page card and a standalone page, and the CLI gained a `--force` flag that skips the frozen comment-count snapshot and re-fetches it for finalised days. Candidate entries are no longer filtered by whether `updated_at` falls inside the window, and truncation is now flagged in the report when collection hits its cap.

`opencode-agent-sandbox` was built out as a knowledge base: an `AGENTS.md` was added, the knowledge directory was generalised beyond Git and GitHub, and notes were archived on OpenCode V2 distribution, architecture, authentication and Windows path pitfalls, plus measured results for oh-my-opencode-slim and hosted OpenCode. Several stale conclusions about subcommand lists, bundled skill counts and Windows ports were corrected.

`opencode-skill-management` shipped the `skill_management` plugin with list, inspect, disable and enable actions, backed by a written specification and feasibility review. Releases went from 0.1.0-rc.0 and rc.1 through v0.2.0 and v1.0.0 to v1.1.0 and v1.2.0; v1.1.0 switched all four actions to a single validated JSON object, and v1.2.0 fixed the divergence count that treated hidden internal agents as visible and the frontmatter boolean parsing that made `inspect` and `list` disagree.

`sopen-translate` started from an empty repository and grew an MV3 skeleton with page translation, then bilingual rendering, chunk splitting, a circuit breaker and progress reporting. A provider protocol layer, presets, model lists and a glossary pipeline followed, along with JSDoc-based `checkJs` type checking, a DOM smoke test for two-round restore, state resets between runs and required-field validation. Selection translation was dropped in favour of page translation only.

`pixel-logo-toolkit` gained automatic text wrapping with overflow protection, a bilingual CLI, an English-first README with a Chinese version, and a 40-image command example gallery. Korean was switched to the Galmuri font because Ark Pixel's ko build lacks Hangul, and explicit right-side decorations now reserve their width. It released v0.2.0 and v0.3.0.

`opencode-go-model-picker` released v1.4.0, v2.0.0, v3.0.0 and v3.0.1. The work covered shared JSON and proxy helpers, fuller agent discovery with `skippedBuiltins` and new flags, atomic snapshot writes, a version badge derived from `SKILL.md`, priced accounting with per-message cost checks, and a large documentation cut in 3.0.0 that reduced the model-facing text from about 104,000 to about 8,300 characters.

Smaller work: `dsh-ecosystem-report` got mobile viewport fixes at 375 and 414 pixels, a single-button theme menu with SVG favicon, visual refinements, three plugins merged into the resource list and a GitHub repository button. `asset-inventory` corrected skill invocation facts across rules, samples and guides and released v1.15.4 and v1.15.5. `myBlog` received four OpenChamber capture samples.

### Upstream issue work

Outside own repositories, 16 issue actions went to `openchamber/openchamber` and 11 to `anomalyco/opencode`, mostly bug reports on session retention hints, MCP settings, quote-card navigation, file-view commenting, context panel percentages, capture resolution and MiMo image handling. One issue was opened on `microsoft/PowerToys` about a NullReferenceException in Shortcut Guide hold-Win activation. Eight discussions were started or commented on in `openchamber/openchamber`, covering file-view commenting, VS Code extension fallback and session statistics. No pull requests or reviews were recorded in the window, and no days are missing.

highlights.text: v3.0.0 cut the model-facing documentation from about 104,000 to about 8,300 characters.
v1.1.0 changed all four skill_management actions to return one JSON object validated against a declared schema.
v0.3.0 added automatic text wrapping and overflow protection with a 9px font floor.
Opened and closed a temporary opencode /oc smoke test issue.
Reported that Settings > MCP omits the Console MCP server that OpenCode adds at runtime.
Reported that mimo-v2.6-flash and mimo-v2.5 advertise image input but the Go endpoint rejects every image.
Opened a Shortcut Guide report about a NullReferenceException on hold-Win activation.
Started an idea discussion about commenting on selected code rather than only selected line numbers.

zh.headline: 11 个仓库共 405 次本人提交、715 次自动提交，另有 34 次 issue 互动
zh.teaser: 本期主要投入日报流水线、OpenCode 代理沙箱、技能管理与翻译扩展，Go 模型选择器连发四个版本。
zh.overview:
### 自有项目

工作重心在日报仓库 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`：AI 摘要层做了重构，去掉了重复的空内容拦截，空白日不再吞掉 discussion 等附加段落，非 GitHub 邮箱别名的提交也能正确归属。新增了近 30 天 GitHub 活动 AI 总结，同时提供首页卡片和独立页面；CLI 增加 `--force`，可跳过评论数快照冻结并重新抓取已定稿日期的快照。候选条目不再按 `updated_at` 是否落在窗口内过滤，采集命中上限时会在日报中标注截断。

`opencode-agent-sandbox` 被搭建成知识库：新增 `AGENTS.md`，知识目录从只限 Git/GitHub 扩展为通用知识，归档了 OpenCode V2 的分发、架构、认证与 Windows 路径坑，以及 oh-my-opencode-slim 和托管 OpenCode 的实测结论，并修正了子命令列表、随包 skill 数量、Windows 端口等过期结论。

`opencode-skill-management` 实现了 `skill_management` 插件的 list、inspect、disable、enable 四个动作，并配套规范文档与可行性评测。版本从 0.1.0-rc.0、rc.1 一路发到 v0.2.0、v1.0.0、v1.1.0 和 v1.2.0；v1.1.0 把四个动作统一改为带 schema 校验的单个 JSON 对象，v1.2.0 修复了把隐藏内部代理算作可见代理导致的分歧计数，以及 frontmatter 布尔解析让 `inspect` 与 `list` 结论不一致的问题。

`sopen-translate` 从空仓库起步，先做出带页面翻译的 MV3 骨架，随后加入双语渲染、分块、熔断与进度显示，再补上 provider 协议层、预设、模型列表与术语表流水线，并加入基于 JSDoc 的 `checkJs` 类型检查、两轮恢复的 DOM 冒烟测试、运行间状态重置和必填校验。划词翻译被移除，只保留页面翻译。

`pixel-logo-toolkit` 增加了自动折行与溢出保护、中英双语命令行、英文优先并附中文版的 README，以及 40 张命令示例画廊。韩语改用 Galmuri 字体，因为 Ark Pixel 的 ko 版不含谚文；显式请求右侧装饰时会为其让出宽度。期间发布 v0.2.0 与 v0.3.0。

`opencode-go-model-picker` 发布了 v1.4.0、v2.0.0、v3.0.0 和 v3.0.1。内容包括共享的 JSON 与代理辅助脚本、更完整的代理发现（含 `skippedBuiltins` 与新参数）、原子快照写入、由 `SKILL.md` 推导的版本徽章、按消息核对成本的计价核算，以及 3.0.0 中把模型需阅读的文档从约 10.4 万字符压到约 8300 字符的大幅精简。

其余工作：`dsh-ecosystem-report` 修复了 375 与 414 像素视口的移动端布局，把主题切换改为单按钮加菜单并补 SVG favicon，做了视觉精修，把 3 个插件并入资料库清单，并加上 GitHub 仓库按钮。`asset-inventory` 修正了规则、示例与指南中的 skill 调用说法，发布 v1.15.4 与 v1.15.5。`myBlog` 新增 4 张 OpenChamber 截图样例。

### 上游 issue 互动

自有仓库之外，`openchamber/openchamber` 有 16 次 issue 互动，`anomalyco/opencode` 有 11 次，多为缺陷报告，涉及会话保留提示、MCP 设置、引用卡片跳转、文件视图评论、上下文面板占比、截图分辨率与 MiMo 图片处理。另在 `microsoft/PowerToys` 提交了一条关于 Shortcut Guide 按住 Win 激活时抛 NullReferenceException 的报告。在 `openchamber/openchamber` 发起或参与了 8 个讨论，涉及文件视图评论、VS Code 扩展回退与会话统计。窗口内没有 PR 与评审记录，也没有缺失数据的日期。

highlights.text: v3.0.0 把模型需阅读的文档从约 10.4 万字符压缩到约 8300 字符。
v1.1.0 将 skill_management 的四个动作改为返回单个经 schema 校验的 JSON 对象。
v0.3.0 加入自动折行与溢出保护，字号最低降到 9px。
新开并关闭了一个临时的 opencode /oc 冒烟测试 issue。
报告设置中的 MCP 页面遗漏了 OpenCode 运行时添加的 Console MCP 服务器。
报告 mimo-v2.6-flash 与 mimo-v2.5 声明支持图片输入，但 Go 端点对任何图片都返回 400。
提交 Shortcut Guide 按住 Win 激活时抛 NullReferenceException 的报告。
发起讨论，建议文件视图支持对选中代码评论，而不只针对选中行号。
